name: Brutalist Concrete
desc: Massive stippled concrete slabs under an overcast sky, a hard raking sun-shadow sweeping slowly across, and a single blood-red accent pillar pulsing on the beat.

style.doc: hard grey concrete + stipple / schematic white-line blueprint (abstract) / 2-ink grey+red riso / high-contrast noir chiaroscuro / translucent x-ray volumes (abstract)

act.doc: day_arc = shadow rakes one way over ~40s / pendulum = shadow rocks back and forth
